summary: Underfollowed expansion for the power-availability node points to three US-listed candidates sitting closer to electrical delivery than to headline AI compute: Powell Industries for medium-voltage switchgear and packaged electrical systems, MYR Group for transmission/substation and commercial-industrial electrical construction, and IES Holdings for data-center electrical/technology systems plus custom power-distribution infrastructure. This pass intentionally excludes mega-cap leaders except as context. The evidence base is strongest for Powell and IES because both have recent company-reported data-center demand/backlog language; MYR is a plausible second-order grid/EPC beneficiary with direct data-center and substation capability but needs more project/customer verification.
